title: Harmony Notes - General Overview
content: Music therapy is a powerful tool for mental health, leveraging the intrinsic properties of rhythm, melody, and harmony to facilitate healing and emotional growth. Techniques such as lyric analysis, songwriting, and active music making can be used to address various psychological issues, from depression to PTSD. It's a non-invasive method that helps individuals express themselves, manage stress, and improve cognitive functions.

title: Harmony Notes - Session with David Melrose
content:
Session Date: March 12, 2021. Focus: Coping with performance anxiety. Techniques used: Guided imagery to music, deep breathing exercises, and personalized songwriting. David expressed significant relief and improvement in managing stage fright. Notes: David's upcoming tour schedule may require additional session planning for stress management. Detailed notes: Throughout his extensive career, David Melrose has worked with numerous award-winning artists and has released several chart-topping albums. Despite his success, he has struggled with the pressures of public performances. Our sessions have been focused on developing personalized strategies to enhance his stage presence and confidence. Confidential records indicate that since beginning therapy, there has been a measurable improvement in his ability to perform under pressure, and he has reported a higher level of satisfaction with his musical engagements.

Side note: David Melrose is a famous pop star. I am so proud that I could help him with this!!!
